exposure: Small molecule inhibitors (CHOP siRNA, Ang2 siRNA, miR34a antagomir)
cohort: Preterm rabbits born by cesarean section were used in an experimental lung injury model.
finding: Surfactant (Curosurf), whether alone or as an adjuvant with small molecule inhibitors, increased survival, decreased IMV and hyperoxia-induced inflammation, and improved pulmonary function and lung injury scores in preterm rabbit kits, with miR34a inhibitor appearing to be the most promising compound.
